Our inflammation atlas is out in Nature Medicine

February 2026

Our paper Interpretable inflammation landscape of circulating immune cells is now published in Nature Medicine.

We built a single-cell atlas of more than 6.5 million peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 1,047 patients across 19 diseases, spanning infections, immune-mediated inflammatory diseases and cancer. From it, we learned a model of inflammation in circulating immune cells and laid the groundwork for classifying patients with unsupervised and explainable machine learning.

The atlas is shared as a resource for the community. Read the paper: doi:10.1038/s41591-025-04126-3.
